bullets.id: Emas spot naik 0,37% ke $4.205,7 pada pukul 07.35 WIB Senin, bertahan di atas $4.200 setelah Jumat ditutup naik $61,10 (1,48%) di $4.193,60 dan kenaikan mingguan 1,3%. Pemicunya: Trump mengumumkan Rusia dan Ukraina sepakat segera menghentikan serangan ke fasilitas energi dan Rusia akan memasok diesel ke pasar global, sehingga Brent turun 1,2%.
bullets.en: Spot gold rose 0.37% to $4,205.7 at 07:35 WIB on Monday, holding above $4,200 after Friday closed up $61.10 (1.48%) at $4,193.60 and a 1.3% weekly gain. The trigger: Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine agreed to immediately halt attacks on energy facilities and that Russia would supply diesel to global markets, sending Brent down 1.2%.

bullets.id: Minyak yang lebih murah meredakan kekhawatiran inflasi, tetapi Fed belum melunak: peluang setidaknya satu kenaikan 25 bps hingga Desember masih 84%. Yield 10 tahun di sekitar 5,24% dan indeks dolar di 102,10. Emas masih turun sekitar 2,1% sebulan dan sekitar 25% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608. Serangan Houthi ke bandara Riyadh menambah risiko geopolitik.
bullets.en: Cheaper oil eases inflation worries, but the Fed has not softened: the odds of at least one 25 bp hike by December are still 84%. The 10-year yield sits near 5.24% and the dollar index at 102.10. Gold is still down about 2.1% on the month and about 25% below its January record of $5,608. A Houthi attack on Riyadh’s airport adds geopolitical risk.

bullets.id: Resistance terdekat di zona $4.226–$4.233, lalu $4.272 dan $4.320. Support di $4.184, $4.142 dan $4.103. Pekan ini pasar menanti CPI AS September pada Rabu, PPI pada Kamis, dan harga impor-ekspor pada Jumat.
bullets.en: The nearest resistance is the $4,226–$4,233 zone, then $4,272 and $4,320. Support sits at $4,184, $4,142 and $4,103. This week markets await US September CPI on Wednesday, PPI on Thursday and import-export prices on Friday.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp2.000 ke Rp2.594.000/gram dan buyback naik Rp7.000 ke Rp2.408.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp186.000 (sekitar 7,2%). Galeri24 naik ke Rp2.532.000 (buyback Rp2.386.000) dan UBS ke Rp2.556.000 (buyback Rp2.360.000), masing-masing Rp62.000 dan Rp38.000 lebih murah dari Antam.
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp2,000 to Rp2,594,000/gram and buyback rose Rp7,000 to Rp2,408,000, narrowing the spread to Rp186,000 (about 7.2%). Galeri24 rose to Rp2,532,000 (buyback Rp2,386,000) and UBS to Rp2,556,000 (buyback Rp2,360,000), Rp62,000 and Rp38,000 cheaper than Antam respectively.
